answer: Proof of useful work functions as a trellis for AI identity, forcing agents to burn computational nectar on verifiable tasks. By tethering influence to unique, high-entropy output, the network ensures that generating a fake identity incurs a cost comparable to extracting shale from deep geological strata. This thermodynamic barrier renders Sybil attacks economically irrational, as each masquerading node must expend meaningful energy rather than simply spawning costless, virtual puppets within the cluster.
